narrative_summary: In the last 48 hours, there have been multiple drone incidents reported across various regions. Notably, smuggling activities have come to the forefront with reported cases of drug drops into prisons in NSW and Punjab. The IDF's actions against Hezbollah following drone attacks highlight ongoing military tensions. Additionally, airport security has been accentuated with Pittsburgh International embroiled in unauthorized drone defense contract issues. There were emerging concerns of drone threats at southern borders related to cartels. Crashes involving drones have also resulted in fatalities, especially in the context of operations in Gaza, signaling the potential hazards associated with drone technology in military engagements.
